payload.recallText: I was in journalism at Fordham university and was a reporter for the ram-the school newspaper. I wanted to ask the dean about the change in profile of students he wanted. While I asked him a guy smoothed a pie in the dean's face. The dean told me "fuck you." when I asked him for comment. I wrote a story about it and showed it to my editor Jay. Who would go on to win a pulizeter prize later. I  embellished some things in the story like having him wear a mask and cape and giving him a latin catch phrase. I am Catholic so I am familiar. The phrase was I am not an animal in Latin. My editor loved it and said for it to be on page one. I gave the guy a name Pie Man with capital latter's P and M. Pieman contacted me and said he would strike again and told me to meet him outside the library. I was there with a photographer to catch it. He got Angela the student body president. We caught it and I wrote a story about it with a picture. Angela is rumored to get busy with the dean in his office on his desk.  She was also mostly responsible for banning drinks outside. She was the no beer barbeque girl. Just a rumor. Now pie man was famous. I was at a bar.I had a crush on a girl but she didn't know who I was. Now she is asking me if I am pie man. I figure if I say yes she will have sex with me. I tell her yes. She says buy me a drink and tell me all about it.
